AI-Lab Data Center Capacity Planner — wireframe (v0.1)
Cockpit where a planner + an embedded, research-literate agent co-drive site & portfolio decisions. Persistent chat rail (left) + a canvas the agent draws into. Every screen reads across four dimensions: Space · Time · Capital · Risk. Low-fi, mostly mock data.

Reading the sketch
Greyed nav items (Financing, Reports, Data Sources) and veiled panels (e.g. correlation engine) = roadmap, shown to provoke scope discussion. The chat 'tool cards' with 'inspect →' stand in for the separate calc engine (pro forma, system sizing, floor planning) — spec'd after we settle the UI.

Where I want your feedback
1) Is chat-rail + canvas the right split?  2) Do the four dimensions read clearly?  3) Site Feasibility (screen 2) is now the built-out POC — right depth, or too much on one screen?  4) Does the phasing lever + optimization panel read as the primary workflow?
